question.worked_solution:
A quadrilateral has $n=4$ sides. Therefore, the sum of the interior angles of a quadrilateral must be 

$$
\begin{aligned}{180}^{∘}\cdot (n-2) & ={180}^{∘}\cdot (4-2) \\  & ={180}^{∘}\cdot 2 \\  & ={360}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

Let's check this for the above three options:

$$
\begin{aligned}{64}^{∘}+{73}^{∘}+{98}^{∘}+{124}^{∘}={359}^{∘}\,X \\  &  \\ {73}^{∘}+{112}^{∘}+{93}^{∘}+{82}^{∘}={360}^{∘}\,✓ \\  &  \\ {80}^{∘}+{140}^{∘}+{49}^{∘}+{84}^{∘}={353}^{∘}\,X\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, only option II could be the angles of a quadrilateral.
